title: Petition of Michaud Bus Lines, Inc., for a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity, under the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, as amended, for the operation of motor veicles for hire over certain public ways in the cities or towns of Rockport, Gloucester, Essex, Manchester, Wenham, Beverly, Danvers and Salem, pursuant to a contract with the Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority.
